description: This file contains shell functions for analyzing filesystem images, including functions to identify magic words, determine file system types, and calculate aligned sizes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the first 4 bytes of a file and outputs them in hex format.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Checks the size and padding of a root filesystem image to find a specific marker.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type based on magic words and padding markers.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Calculates the smallest multiple of a given number greater than or equal to input.
